sentences.en: And I'm very, very grateful.
sentences.zh: 我非常、非常感激。

sentences.en: But without further ado, let's get into it.
sentences.zh: 废话不多说，我们直接进入正题吧。

sentences.en: I know why we're all here.
sentences.zh: 我知道大家为什么都在这里。

sentences.en: We want to hear about this topic.
sentences.zh: 我们都想听听这个话题。

sentences.en: And today, that's exactly what we're talking about.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们聊的正是这个。

sentences.en: We're talking about how to be at peace with being alone and single in our 20s and the psychology behind why we can often struggle with the reality of being single.
sentences.zh: 我们讨论的是如何在20多岁时与独处和单身状态和平共处，以及为什么我们往往会纠结于单身的现实，其背后的心理机制是什么。

sentences.en: But most importantly, how to actually enjoy this period in our lives, how to flourish and discover more about ourselves, our internal worlds, our thoughts, our beliefs.
sentences.zh: 但最重要的是，如何真正享受我们生命中的这段时期，如何绽放自我，发现更多关于我们自己、我们的内心世界、我们的思想和信仰的东西。

sentences.en: I think as humans, especially in a monogamous society in which so much of our lives and our societal expectations are focused on monogamy and obtaining love and partnership
sentences.zh: 我认为作为人类，尤其是在一个一夫一妻制的社会中，我们的生活和社会期望中有很大一部分都集中在 monogamy（一夫一妻制）以及获得爱情、伴侣

sentences.en: and marriage, we really crave the stability of a partner and want someone to love.
sentences.zh: 和婚姻上，我们确实渴望伴侣的稳定性，想要有人去爱。

sentences.en: And that feeling is entirely okay.
sentences.zh: 这种感觉完全没问题。

sentences.en: It's valid.
sentences.zh: 这是合理的。

sentences.en: It's okay to want a boyfriend or a girlfriend or a partner because deep connections can bring us really deep joy.
sentences.zh: 想要男朋友、女朋友或伴侣是正常的，因为深层的联系确实能给我们带来极大的快乐。

sentences.en: But I think it's also important to be okay being alone, especially when we are young and in our 20s
sentences.zh: 但我认为，学会享受独处也很重要，尤其是在我们年轻的20多岁时，

sentences.en: and not let our relationship status kind of determine our worth or how much we get to enjoy life.
sentences.zh: 不要让我们的恋爱状态来决定我们的价值，或者决定我们能享受多少生活乐趣。

sentences.en: I think romantic love is just one element of a really fulfilled, joyous life.
sentences.zh: 我认为浪漫爱情只是一个充实、快乐生活的一个要素而已。

sentences.en: So it's something I'm really passionate about and love speaking about with my friends.
sentences.zh: 所以我对这个话题非常热衷，也喜欢和朋友们讨论它。

sentences.en: And how can we cultivate self-love and cultivate happiness when we find ourselves single?
sentences.zh: 那么，当我们发现自己单身时，该如何培养自爱和幸福感呢？

sentences.en: I think particularly in our 20s, we can feel a lot of internal and external pressure around being single and not just single but happy with it being that way.
sentences.zh: 我认为特别是在20多岁时，我们可能会感受到很多关于单身的内在和外在压力，而且不仅仅是单身，还要对这种状态感到快乐。

sentences.en: This is especially hard in a decade like our 20s when many of the people around us, many of our friends begin meeting their life partners or getting married.
sentences.zh: 在20多岁这十年里，这尤其困难，因为我们周围的许多人，许多朋友都开始遇到他们的人生伴侣或结婚了。

sentences.en: And it can be a difficult point of comparison when you find yourself alone or without that person.
sentences.zh: 当你发现自己孤身一人或没有那个人的陪伴时，这可能是一个很难不去比较的点。

sentences.en: I fall into this trap quite a lot, especially since so many of my friends are in relationships.
sentences.zh: 我经常陷入这种陷阱，尤其是因为我的很多朋友都在恋爱中。

sentences.en: I remember this time, I think around this time last year, when three of my closest friends,
sentences.zh: 我记得大约是去年的这个时候，我三个最亲密的朋友，

sentences.en: friends of the show, shout out to them, but they all entered long-term committed relationships.
sentences.zh: 也是节目的好朋友，向她们致敬，她们都进入了长期的承诺关系。

sentences.en: And I obviously love their partners.
sentences.zh: 我当然很喜欢她们的伴侣。

sentences.en: I think they're great people.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他们都是很棒的人。

sentences.en: And I genuinely like very much enjoy their company, but it does change dynamics.
sentences.zh: 而且我真心非常享受和他们在一起的时光，但这确实改变了相处模式。

sentences.en: And my friends have someone else to consider in their lives.
sentences.zh: 我的朋友们在生活中有了另一个需要考虑的人。

sentences.en: And they're so amazing at prioritizing their friendships and their own lives.
sentences.zh: 她们在优先考虑友谊和自己的生活方面做得非常棒。

sentences.en: And obviously we're still incredibly close, but as everyone around us seems to find their person
sentences.zh: 显然我们仍然非常亲密，但当周围每个人似乎都找到了属于他们的人，

sentences.en: and have these fantastic love stories and experiences, has someone to adventure with and share something
sentences.zh: 拥有了美妙的爱情故事和经历，有了可以一起冒险、分享事物的人时，

sentences.en: with, it can be really difficult to not feel like something might be wrong with us, that we are
sentences.zh: 很难不去想是不是自己出了什么问题，是不是自己

sentences.en: somehow undeserving, that we'll never have that, that we're missing out or somehow faulty.
sentences.zh: 某种程度上不配拥有，永远不会拥有，或者觉得自己错过了什么，又或者自己有什么缺陷。

sentences.en: And I'm here to say, absolutely none of that is true.
sentences.zh: 而我在这里要说，这些完全都不是真的。

sentences.en: Each of us has our own journey and development and healing and growing to do.
sentences.zh: 我们每个人都有自己的旅程，有自己的成长、治愈和发展的过程。

sentences.en: And maybe your journey right now isn't about finding love.
sentences.zh: 也许你现在的旅程并不是关于寻找爱情。

sentences.en: Maybe it's about finding yourself and discovering what you love to do and who you are when you're alone.
sentences.zh: 也许它是关于寻找自我，发现你喜欢做什么，以及当你独处时你是谁。

sentences.en: You have your entire life to be partnered to someone else and to be connected to them financially, socially, emotionally, socially, intimately.
sentences.zh: 你有整整一辈子的时间去和别人结为伴侣，在经济、社交、情感、亲密关系上与他们相连。

sentences.en: And there will definitely come times in any long-term relationship where we will wish for
sentences.zh: 在任何长期关系中，肯定会有那么一些时刻，我们会怀念

sentences.en: the days when we were single and only needed to rely on ourselves, only needed to make decisions for ourselves.
sentences.zh: 那些单身的日子，那时我们只需要依靠自己，只需要为自己做决定。

sentences.en: When you do find someone, I think I can probably definitely say you're going to look back at
sentences.zh: 当你真的找到某人时，我想我可以肯定地说，你会在某个时刻回望

sentences.en: this moment at some point right now when you're single and you're by yourself, you're thriving,
sentences.zh: 现在的这一刻，当你单身，当你独自一人，你正在蓬勃发展，

sentences.en: you're independent, and you're going to look back with nostalgia and wish you'd appreciated this time more.
sentences.zh: 你很独立，你会带着怀旧的心情回望，并希望自己当时能更珍惜这段时光。

sentences.en: When I feel like I want a partner or I'm lacking something because I don't have one, I think about this all the time.
sentences.zh: 每当我感到想要一个伴侣，或者因为没有伴侣而觉得缺少什么时，我都会一直这样想。

sentences.en: It brings me a lot of comfort.
sentences.zh: 这给了我很大的安慰。

sentences.en: But I think that doesn't mean that we're not allowed to have times when we may want a relationship.
sentences.zh: 但这并不意味着我们不允许有想要一段关系的时候。

sentences.en: We don't have to push that feeling away.
sentences.zh: 我们不必把那种感觉推开。

sentences.en: We don't have to completely deny that kind of desire, that aspect of ourselves in order to be happy and single.
sentences.zh: 为了保持单身的快乐，我们不必完全否认那种渴望，否认我们自身的那一部分。

sentences.en: I think it's totally okay to crave connection and to want someone.
sentences.zh: 我认为渴望联系、想要某人陪伴是完全没问题的。

sentences.en: I personally had a moment like that the other day.
sentences.zh: 我个人前几天就有过这样的时刻。

sentences.en: Like I mentioned, this show has gained so many new listeners recently.
sentences.zh: 就像我提到的，这个节目最近获得了这么多新听众。

sentences.en: And to be honest, it can be really overwhelming to feel deserving of this kind of audience and
sentences.zh: 老实说，感到自己配得上这样的观众，并且

sentences.en: to continue to put out episodes that I really want to do without feeling pressure to kind of deliver on what people want to hear.
sentences.zh: 在没有压力去满足人们想听的内容的情况下，继续制作我真正想做的节目，这真的让人感到不知所措。

sentences.en: Um, and it honestly made me really emotional.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这真的让我很感性。

sentences.en: And in that moment, I did wish that I just had someone who loved me to kind of hug me and tell me it was okay.
sentences.zh: 在那一刻，我确实希望有一个爱我的人能抱抱我，告诉我一切都会好起来的。

sentences.en: And they were proud of me.
sentences.zh: 并且为我感到骄傲。

sentences.en: And yeah, that would have been really nice.
sentences.zh: 是的，那真的会很好。

sentences.en: But I also realized that that was kind of a learned behavior for me to crave romantic connection in times of stress or when I'm overwhelmed.
sentences.zh: 但我也意识到，在压力大或不知所措时渴望浪漫联系，对我来说是一种习得性行为。

sentences.en: And just because I don't have that one person doesn't mean I have no one.
sentences.zh: 仅仅因为我没有那个人，并不意味着我一无所有。

sentences.en: Just because I can't share good news with a partner doesn't mean I can't share it with my family and my friends.
sentences.zh: 仅仅因为我不能和伴侣分享好消息，并不意味着我不能和家人朋友分享。

sentences.en: Like for example, um, like the other day I got this like really amazing piece of news and I shared it with my friend Kate and her reaction was just as meaningful than if I'd
sentences.zh: 比如前几天，我得到了一个非常棒的消息，我把它分享给了我的朋友Kate，她的反应比我

sentences.en: shared the news with any of the people I dated in the past, because that relationship and that friendship I have with her has outlasted all of those people.
sentences.zh: 过去约会过的任何人都要有意义，因为我和她之间的那种关系和友谊比那些人都更长久。

sentences.en: Her support is unconditional and reliable.
sentences.zh: 她的支持是无条件的，也是可靠的。

sentences.en: And it was such a valuable realization for me.
sentences.zh: 这对我有很大的启发。

sentences.en: You know, no one is missing out just because they're single.
sentences.zh: 你知道，没有人会因为单身而错过什么。

sentences.en: And in this episode, I really want to be able to discuss how we can create lives we enjoy and love so much that we're really not bothered by being alone.
sentences.zh: 在这一期节目中，我真的希望能讨论我们如何创造出让我们如此享受和热爱的生活，以至于我们根本不会因为独处而感到困扰。

sentences.en: And the opportunity this period gives us to build a solid foundation for ourselves that will pay off in the future is something we appreciate.
sentences.zh: 这段时期给予我们机会，为自己建立一个坚实的基础，这在未来会得到回报，这是我们应该珍惜的。

sentences.en: Even when we do enter a relationship, a relationship, or if we decide we like being alone, this is such
sentences.zh: 即使当我们进入一段关系，或者如果我们决定自己喜欢独处，这对于我们年轻人来说都是一个非常

sentences.en: an important period when we're young to be able to really decide what we want and put effort and time into that.
sentences.zh: 重要的时期，能够真正决定我们想要什么，并为此投入精力和时间。

sentences.en: There is so much content, so much psychology to discuss today.
sentences.zh: 今天有太多的内容，太多的心理学知识要讨论了。

sentences.en: I'm so excited by the research I found and being able to share this with you so that if you are single right now and maybe feeling a bit lonely or wanting a relationship, you can
sentences.zh: 我对我的研究发现感到非常兴奋，并能与你们分享，这样如果你现在单身，可能感到有点孤独或想要一段关系，你就可以

sentences.en: reframe your relationship with yourself and with romance to realize that really you're kind
sentences.zh: 重塑你与自己以及与浪漫的关系，意识到其实你

sentences.en: of all you need to be happy and you can be the best version of yourself even without a partner.
sentences.zh: 本身就是快乐所需的一切，即使没有伴侣，你也能成为最好的自己。

sentences.en: So buckle in.
sentences.zh: 所以系好安全带吧。

sentences.en: I'm so excited and I hope we all learn something today.
sentences.zh: 我非常兴奋，希望我们今天都能学到一些东西。

sentences.en: Okay, so I think that it is a blessing to be single in our 20s.
sentences.zh: 好的，我认为在20多岁时单身是一种福气。

sentences.en: Like I mentioned before, I think our society really seems to have this strange obsession with long-term relationships and marriage and holy matrimony.
sentences.zh: 就像我之前提到的，我认为我们的社会似乎对长期关系、婚姻和神圣的结合有一种奇怪的执念。

sentences.en: And yes, that is a beautiful thing.
sentences.zh: 是的，那是一件美好的事情。

sentences.en: But the flip side of this weird obsession with love and soulmates and relationships is that
sentences.zh: 但这种对爱情、灵魂伴侣和关系的奇怪执念的另一面是，

sentences.en: for people probably like yourself who are single right now, we can feel like our lives are meaningless unless we have someone else to share it with.
sentences.zh: 对于像你这样现在单身的人来说，我们可能会觉得，除非有另一个人来分享，否则我们的生活毫无意义。

sentences.en: We may also feel almost pitied or like we are never going to be whole until we've achieved some form of connection or unity with another person.
sentences.zh: 我们甚至可能感到被怜悯，或者觉得除非我们与另一个人实现了某种形式的联系或统一，否则我们永远不会完整。

sentences.en: Social norms or societal expectations like this can be really powerful.
sentences.zh: 像这样的社会规范或社会期望是非常强大的。

sentences.en: Societal expectations, they're essentially guidelines for our behavior or expectations placed on us, such as the need to be married, and they kind of cause us to conform with the
sentences.zh: 社会期望，它们本质上是我们行为的准则或强加给我们的期望，比如结婚的必要性，它们促使我们去顺应

sentences.en: norm or the status quo of everyone else's behavior.
sentences.zh: 规范或其他人行为的现状。

sentences.en: Often, I think a justification for an expectation like long-term partnership or commitment is
sentences.zh: 通常，我认为对长期伴侣或承诺这种期望的辩护是，

sentences.en: that it leads to a better society, it's better for us, it makes our quality of life better.
sentences.zh: 它能带来一个更好的社会，对我们更好，能提高我们的生活质量。

sentences.en: But we still feel this sense of pressure, this need to conform.
sentences.zh: 但我们仍然感受到这种压力，这种顺应的需要。

sentences.en: And we see this expectation playing out all around us in countless songs and hits about love, in romantic comedies where the protagonist is made complete by finding the one, in our
sentences.zh: 我们在周围无数关于爱情的歌曲和热门作品中，在浪漫喜剧中（主角通过找到“那个人”而变得完整），在我们的

sentences.en: friendship groups and workplaces, in novels and stories about the power of true love.
sentences.zh: 朋友圈和工作场所，在关于真爱力量的小说和故事中，都能看到这种期望在发挥作用。

sentences.en: But when it comes to being single, I think the idea that your life is not full until it contains
sentences.zh: 但当谈到单身时，我认为“你的生活如果不包含另一个人就不完整”这种想法

sentences.en: another person is like utterly nonsense and can lead to a lot of stigmatization and negative self-talk for those of us who are alone right now.
sentences.zh: 简直是无稽之谈，并且可能导致我们这些现在独处的人受到很多污名化和负面的自我对话。

sentences.en: You can still lead a tremendous, fabulous life whilst you're alone.
sentences.zh: 即使你独自一人，你仍然可以过上精彩、美妙的生活。

sentences.en: Also, because we, you know, we're not alone, are we?
sentences.zh: 而且，因为我们，你知道，我们并不孤单，对吧？

sentences.en: Like, I think maybe that word has a lot of negative connotations, like I'm alone because I don't have someone, but that's never really the case.
sentences.zh: 我觉得“孤独”这个词可能有很多负面含义，比如“我孤独是因为我没有伴侣”，但事实从来都不是这样。

sentences.en: Like you're surrounded by so many people who can support you and provide the encouragement and love that a partner has.
sentences.zh: 你被许多人包围着，他们可以支持你，提供伴侣所能给予的鼓励和爱。

sentences.en: And often in a way that's more sustainable and fulfilling than if you do decide to date someone who's not right for you, just to enjoy the feeling that you have a partner.
sentences.zh: 而且通常这种方式比你仅仅为了享受有伴侣的感觉而和一个不适合你的人约会，要更持久、更充实。

sentences.en: In fact, it's a proven fact, a proven fact, people, that it's not just our partners or those
sentences.zh: 事实上，这是一个被证明的事实，被证明的事实，各位，创造幸福的不仅仅是我们的伴侣或那些

sentences.en: we are in relationships with that create happiness, but the quality of our relationships with our friends and our families.
sentences.zh: 我们处于恋爱关系中的人，而是我们与朋友和家人关系的质量。

sentences.en: In fact, while I was researching this episode, I found this study that was done by a number of positive psychologists.
sentences.zh: 事实上，当我在研究这一期节目时，我发现了这项由多位积极心理学家完成的研究。

sentences.en: Positive is a field within psychology, not just an adjective to describe these researchers, but they determined that it is our positive emotional experiences with people across our
sentences.zh: “积极”是心理学中的一个领域，不仅仅是形容这些研究人员的形容词，但他们确定，正是我们与人之间积极的情感体验，贯穿了我们的

sentences.en: lives that is the largest predictor of happiness.
sentences.zh: 生活，是幸福感最大的预测指标。

sentences.en: One person is not going to be enough to make you happy.
sentences.zh: 单靠一个人是无法让你感到幸福的。

sentences.en: You need to feel properly supported and loved by people from all areas of your life.
sentences.zh: 你需要感受到来自生活各个方面的人给予的适当支持与关爱。

sentences.en: So let us talk about some of the amazing benefits of being single in your 20s and some of the great
sentences.zh: 所以，让我们来聊聊二十多岁时保持单身的一些惊人益处，以及它带给我们的

sentences.en: opportunities it gives us to kind of counteract some of those inner doubts and internalized expectations that come from society.
sentences.zh: 一些绝佳机会，让我们能够抵消掉那些来自社会的内在疑虑和内化的期望。

sentences.en: First of all, it might actually be the case that singleness actually makes us happier in the long run.
sentences.zh: 首先，从长远来看，单身实际上可能真的会让我们更快乐。

sentences.en: So this study done by a professor of behavioral science out of London found that single women
sentences.zh: 伦敦一位行为科学教授所做的研究发现，单身且没有孩子的女性，

sentences.en: with no children are actually generally happier than those who are married or those who have children.
sentences.zh: 总体上确实比已婚或有孩子的女性更快乐。

sentences.en: This professor reported that these people, these single women, have more free time, greater independence, more money, and an overall sense of well-being.
sentences.zh: 这位教授指出，这些人，也就是这些单身女性，拥有更多的自由时间、更强的独立性、更多的金钱，以及整体上的幸福感。

sentences.en: But for men and for my male listeners, I know that's not many of you, but the opposite is actually the case.
sentences.zh: 但对于男性，以及我的男性听众们——我知道你们不多——情况却恰恰相反。

sentences.en: It seems that men actually benefit more from marriage and partnership than women.
sentences.zh: 男性似乎确实比女性更能从婚姻和伴侣关系中获益。

sentences.en: And men who are in long-term relationships are actually marginally happier than those who are not.
sentences.zh: 处于长期关系中的男性，实际上比那些单身男性稍微快乐一点。

sentences.en: So obviously, these statements are quite controversial and were met with quite a bit of criticism, which I get.
sentences.zh: 显然，这些说法颇具争议，也招致了不少批评，我对此表示理解。

sentences.en: It's understandable.
sentences.zh: 这是可以理解的。

sentences.en: If you are a married woman, you probably aren't going to take too kindly to someone telling you that you are destined to misery because you happen to find someone you love.
sentences.zh: 如果你是一位已婚女性，听到有人说你因为恰好找到了爱人就注定要痛苦，你大概不会觉得好受。

sentences.en: And I hope that we all know that's not what I'm saying here.
sentences.zh: 我希望大家都明白，我并不是这个意思。

sentences.en: And I think the biggest lesson to take away from this is that happiness is relative.
sentences.zh: 我认为从中能学到的最大教训是：幸福是相对的。

sentences.en: And it's not the case that singleness is, in no uncertain terms, going to make you miserable.
sentences.zh: 并不是说单身就绝对会让你痛苦。

sentences.en: In fact, from this research, it actually seems it's the opposite.
sentences.zh: 事实上，从这项研究来看，情况恰恰相反。

sentences.en: I also don't think we can assume that what this research is saying is that people in relationships are necessarily sad and depressed and dissatisfied.
sentences.zh: 我也不认为我们可以断定，这项研究是在说处于恋爱关系中的人就一定悲伤、抑郁且不满。

sentences.en: It's definitely a case-by-case basis.
sentences.zh: 这绝对是因人而异的。

sentences.en: And I think there are so many people out there who are in awful relationships that might actually
sentences.zh: 我认为有很多人身处糟糕的关系中，这可能会

sentences.en: pull down the average, noting that I think it's always better to be alone than in the company of someone or in a relationship that is not serving you or is toxic or nasty.
sentences.zh: 拉低平均水平。我一直认为，独处总比与一个不适合你、或者关系有毒、糟糕的人在一起要好。

sentences.en: That is a really good segue, I think, into exploring some of the other emotional, social, intellectual, spiritual benefits of singleness in our 20s.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这是一个很好的过渡，让我们去探索二十多岁时单身在情感、社交、智力及精神层面上的其他益处。

sentences.en: Firstly, you have time to discover who you are and to improve yourself.
sentences.zh: 首先，你有时间去发现自我并提升自我。

sentences.en: Let's be really honest here.
sentences.zh: 我们坦诚一点吧。

sentences.en: Relationships take up a lot of time.
sentences.zh: 恋爱关系会占据大量时间。

sentences.en: If you are committed to a person and getting to know them and sharing your life with them, that is going to require a large investment of your time and your energy.
sentences.zh: 如果你致力于与某人交往，去了解对方并分享生活，那将需要投入大量的时间和精力。

sentences.en: And, you know, you also want to be around them all the time.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，你也会想一直和他们待在一起。

sentences.en: I am sure a lot of us can understand that feeling of falling in love and never wanting to be away from that person.
sentences.zh: 我相信我们很多人都能理解那种坠入爱河、一刻也不想离开对方的感觉。

sentences.en: But sometimes that comes at a coSt.
sentences.zh: 但有时这是有代价的。

sentences.en: When you're single, you get to use that time that you would otherwise have spent with a partner to focus only on you and what feeds your soul and allows you to grow.
sentences.zh: 当你单身时，你可以利用原本会花在伴侣身上的时间，专注于自己，专注于那些滋养你灵魂并让你成长的事物。

sentences.en: And I think this really perfectly links to our next point.
sentences.zh: 我认为这一点与我们接下来的观点衔接得非常完美。

sentences.en: Being single in our 20s gives us more time to focus on our dreams and our ambitions, more time to study, to go to the gym, to pursue a new hobby, to spend time on our career.
sentences.zh: 二十多岁时单身，让我们有更多时间专注于梦想和抱负，有更多时间学习、健身、追求新爱好，以及投入到事业中。

sentences.en: So, fun fact, I actually started this podcast after a breakup with a long-term partner
sentences.zh: 说个趣事，我其实是在结束了一段长期恋情后开始做这个播客的，

sentences.en: when I was feeling really shit about being alone and had all of this spare time I didn't really know
sentences.zh: 当时我因为独处而感到非常糟糕，拥有了所有这些我真的不知道

sentences.en: what to do with and being single gave me so many evenings to create episodes I loved and to be able to create something I was proud of.
sentences.zh: 该怎么打发的空闲时间。单身给了我许多个夜晚去创作我热爱的剧集，并能创造出让我引以为傲的东西。

sentences.en: And we rarely get the time in our lives where we can be entirely selfish and we're able to really focus on the core foundations of our lives
sentences.zh: 我们一生中很少有时间可以完全自私，能够真正专注于生活的核心基础，

sentences.en: to create something that we're proud of or focus on a major goal.
sentences.zh: 去创造一些我们引以为傲的东西，或者专注于一个重大目标。

sentences.en: When you're single, that's one of the huge upsides.
sentences.zh: 当你单身时，这就是巨大的优势之一。

sentences.en: You get the opportunity to explore new things, new hobbies, to practice self-love, to go on solo adventures and travel and not be distracted by a relationship.
sentences.zh: 你有机会去探索新事物、新爱好，练习自爱，进行独自冒险和旅行，而不被恋爱关系所干扰。

sentences.en: Essentially, you get to figure shit out on your own and you get to figure it out by yourself and be your own person.
sentences.zh: 本质上，你可以自己去搞定一切，靠自己去弄明白，成为独立的个体。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I don't know if you've noticed this, but sometimes I see like couples or people who've been together for a long time and they don't know how to live without each other.
sentences.zh: 不知道你有没有注意到，有时我看到情侣或在一起很久的人，他们不知道如何离开对方生活。

sentences.en: They don't have their own aspirations or their own goals.
sentences.zh: 他们没有自己的抱负或目标。

sentences.en: They kind of meld into one person.
sentences.zh: 他们似乎融合成了一个人。

sentences.en: When you're single for a longer period of time, you get the opportunity to figure out what you want and how you feel.
sentences.zh: 当你单身较长一段时间后，你有机会弄清楚自己想要什么以及自己的感受。

sentences.en: There's no one to compromise with.
sentences.zh: 没有人需要去妥协。

sentences.en: You're not attached to someone else.
sentences.zh: 你没有依附于别人。

sentences.en: Your identity isn't kind of melded with theirs.
sentences.zh: 你的身份没有与对方混淆。

sentences.en: Another perk, you can do whatever you want.
sentences.zh: 另一个好处是，你可以做任何你想做的事。

sentences.en: Like you can go and get ice cream like right now.
sentences.zh: 比如你现在就可以去买冰淇淋。

sentences.en: You don't have to tell anyone.
sentences.zh: 你不需要告诉任何人。

sentences.en: You can eat wherever you want for dinner every single night of the week.
sentences.zh: 你每周的每一天晚上都可以随心所欲地选择晚餐地点。

sentences.en: You don't have to visit in-laws.
sentences.zh: 你不需要去拜访姻亲。

sentences.en: You know, decision making is so much easier.
sentences.zh: 你知道，做决定要容易得多。

sentences.en: And another perk, especially if you're someone who's maybe been in a long-term relationship before or after that, is that you don't have to share money.
sentences.zh: 另一个好处是，特别是如果你曾经或之后处于长期关系中，那就是你不需要共享金钱。

sentences.en: I'm sure not all couples do this, but it is an expectation, especially if you're getting married or you're getting really serious.
sentences.zh: 我相信并非所有情侣都这样，但这是一种期望，特别是如果你要结婚或关系变得非常认真时。

sentences.en: But when you're single, like that money is all yours.
sentences.zh: 但当你单身时，钱全是你的。

sentences.en: You are completely kind of independent in your finances.
sentences.zh: 你在财务上是完全独立的。

sentences.en: You're going to make your own decisions like, okay, you want to go and spend $100 at Sephora or whatever, like that's fine.
sentences.zh: 你可以自己做决定，比如，好吧，你想去丝芙兰花100美元或者其他什么，这完全没问题。

sentences.en: You're not saving for a house with anyone.
sentences.zh: 你不需要和任何人一起存钱买房。

sentences.en: You don't have to answer to anyone about how you spend your finances.
sentences.zh: 你不需要向任何人交代你的财务支出。

sentences.en: And I know it's not the 1950s.
sentences.zh: 我知道现在不是1950年代了。

sentences.en: And if you're someone who is in a relationship listening to this, I hope you're not offended.
sentences.zh: 如果你正处于恋爱关系中并听着这些，我希望你不要被冒犯。

sentences.en: I know that women have independence over their money, but it is something to consider.
sentences.zh: 我知道女性对自己的钱有支配权，但这确实是值得考虑的一点。

sentences.en: Another really big upside is you get to practice complete independence.
sentences.zh: 另一个非常大的优势是，你可以练习完全的独立。

sentences.en: Now, as we know as good students of psychology, hyper-independence can actually be quite harmful.
sentences.zh: 现在，作为心理学的优秀学生，我们知道过度独立实际上可能相当有害。

sentences.en: And it's often a coping mechanism or response to trauma.
sentences.zh: 它通常是一种应对机制或对创伤的反应。

sentences.en: That's not really what we're talking about here.
sentences.zh: 这并不是我们这里要讨论的重点。

sentences.en: So hyper-independence is like really not being able to depend on anyone, not being able to trust anyone.
sentences.zh: 过度独立就像是完全无法依赖任何人，无法信任任何人。

sentences.en: And it often arises as a result of deep emotional baggage by betrayal or abandonment, a sense of unsafety around other previous relationships.
sentences.zh: 它通常源于背叛或遗弃带来的深层情感包袱，以及在之前关系中产生的不安全感。

sentences.en: You know, if you've been cheated on or hurt by a partner, often our reaction to that is to become hyper-independent and to need no one.
sentences.zh: 你知道，如果你曾被伴侣欺骗或伤害过，我们通常的反应就是变得过度独立，不再需要任何人。

sentences.en: And it results in you really struggling to build deep connections and rely on others out of fear of being hurt, even when you want to.
sentences.zh: 这导致你即使在想要建立深层联系时，也因为害怕受伤而难以依赖他人。

sentences.en: But a little bit of independence is always good, I think, especially in your 20s.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，拥有适度的独立总是好的，尤其是在二十多岁时。

sentences.en: You know, you learn to trust yourself.
sentences.zh: 你知道，你学会了信任自己。

sentences.en: You learn how to regulate your emotions on your own, how to do things alone, which is so
sentences.zh: 你学会了如何独自调节情绪，如何独自完成事情，这真是

sentences.en: amazing, and you know that no matter what happens, you can always do it by yourself and be perfectly fine no matter what.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。你知道无论发生什么，你总能靠自己搞定，无论如何都能过得很好。

sentences.en: That is such an important thing to recognize and acknowledge, and it makes you stronger.
sentences.zh: 认识到并承认这一点非常重要，它会让你变得更强大。

sentences.en: I think another huge benefit I've noticed in my own personal life and on anecdotal level
sentences.zh: 我认为我在自己的生活中以及从朋友那里观察到的另一个巨大益处，

sentences.en: from friends is the deep connections you're able to build with the people around you, especially your close friends.
sentences.zh: 是你能够与周围的人，特别是亲密朋友建立深厚的联系。

sentences.en: One of the major benefits of being single and being happy in your 20s is having the time to spend with your friends, and it actually increases the number of social connections
sentences.zh: 二十多岁时单身且快乐的主要益处之一，就是有时间陪伴朋友，这实际上增加了你可能拥有的

sentences.en: you might have.
sentences.zh: 社交联系数量。

sentences.en: So there was this interesting study that basically concluded that people who are single actually have more social connections and more independent social connections.
sentences.zh: 有一项有趣的研究得出结论：单身人士实际上拥有更多的社交联系，以及更独立的社交关系。

sentences.en: That's because when we don't have a relationship, we don't have a primary relationship, we kind
sentences.zh: 这是因为当我们没有恋爱关系，没有主要伴侣时，我们

sentences.en: of need to reach out more to your connections and your social networks, because those are the people
sentences.zh: 需要更多地去接触我们的社交网络，因为这些人

sentences.en: who are going to provide us with the support that we need rather than, you know, our partner or rather than like your married counterpart or someone who is by your side.
sentences.zh: 才是能为我们提供所需支持的人，而不是你的伴侣，也不是你已婚的同龄人或身边的人。

sentences.en: And I don't think we can understate the importance of strong friendships, regardless of your relationship status.
sentences.zh: 无论你的恋爱状态如何，我们都不能低估深厚友谊的重要性。

sentences.en: But I think a lot of us would see that when we are alone and when we don't have a partner,
sentences.zh: 但我认为我们很多人都会发现，当我们独处且没有伴侣时，

sentences.en: immediately one of the first things we do is call up our friends, spend so much more time
sentences.zh: 我们做的第一件事往往就是打电话给朋友，花更多时间

sentences.en: with them, get to go out and party and or stay in and paint.
sentences.zh: 和他们在一起，出去聚会，或者待在家里画画。

sentences.en: Like whatever you want to do, you're able to cultivate those friendships.
sentences.zh: 无论你想做什么，你都有能力去培养那些友谊。

sentences.en: Let's not forget, it's not just friendships you get to develop, but other types of relationships.
sentences.zh: 别忘了，你不仅能发展友谊，还能发展其他类型的关系。

sentences.en: When you're not in a committed relationship, there is often, you know, and often in a committed
sentences.zh: 当你没有处于承诺关系中时，通常——在承诺

sentences.en: relationship, there's this norm of being exclusive or only having sex with each other.
sentences.zh: 关系中，往往存在一种排他性或只与对方发生性关系的规范。

sentences.en: Obviously, if you're in an open relationship, that may be different.
sentences.zh: 当然，如果你处于开放式关系中，情况可能不同。

sentences.en: But for most of us who are single, we get the opportunity to have sex with whoever we want, whenever we want it.
sentences.zh: 但对于我们大多数单身人士来说，我们有机会与任何我们想在一起的人，在任何我们想的时候发生性关系。

sentences.en: Like we get the freedom to explore new sexual partners and meet people and be sexually adventurous.
sentences.zh: 我们拥有探索新性伴侣、结识新朋友并进行性冒险的自由。

sentences.en: Maybe that's not your cup of tea.
sentences.zh: 也许那不是你的菜。

sentences.en: Totally OK.
sentences.zh: 完全没问题。

sentences.en: But sometimes it's really liberating to be with new people and to try new things out.
sentences.zh: 但有时与新人在一起并尝试新事物确实非常令人解放。

sentences.en: And sometimes we just need to be alone to unlearn habits or patterns that are emotionally unhealthy.
sentences.zh: 有时我们只是需要独处来改掉那些情感上不健康的习惯或模式。

sentences.en: So when my last situationship, like relationship thing, whatever we want to call it, when it
sentences.zh: 所以当我上一段“情境关系”（随便我们怎么称呼它）结束时，

sentences.en: ended, I realized that in my pursuit of love, I'd kind of acted in a way that I didn't like.
sentences.zh: 我意识到在追求爱的过程中，我的行为方式是我自己不喜欢的。

sentences.en: I had neglected friendships and important people in my life.
sentences.zh: 我忽视了友谊和生命中重要的人。

sentences.en: And it was a really hard truth that I had to acknowledge about myself that I craved romantic love above everything else.
sentences.zh: 这是一个我必须承认的关于自己的残酷真相：我渴望浪漫之爱胜过一切。

sentences.en: So much so that I was really willing to sacrifice important things to me just to be with someone
sentences.zh: 以至于我真的愿意为了和某人在一起而牺牲对我来说重要的东西，

sentences.en: who didn't really have to give anything up and got all the benefits while I really lost out and it cost me.
sentences.zh: 而对方却不需要放弃任何东西，获得了所有的好处，而我却损失惨重，付出了代价。

sentences.en: So I made this conscious decision to take a break and to focus on myself, to unlearn this dependency mindset.
sentences.zh: 所以我做出了一个清醒的决定：休息一下，专注于自己，改掉这种依赖心态。

sentences.en: I had this unconscious need to be loved and admired and craved.
sentences.zh: 我有一种潜意识里想要被爱、被崇拜和被渴望的需求。

sentences.en: And I had to take a step back and deliberately heal the insecurities that had caused this.
sentences.zh: 我必须退后一步，刻意去治愈导致这一切的不安全感。

sentences.en: And, you know, here we are now.
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道，我们现在就在这里了。

sentences.en: So I think I've done a bit of learning from that situation and I wouldn't have been able to do it if immediately after that situationship had ended, I jumped into something new.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为我从那次经历中学到了一些东西，如果在那段情境关系结束后我立即跳入一段新关系，我是无法做到这一点的。

sentences.en: I think if that had been the case, I would have ended up in the exact same situation with the exact same type of person, never having developed the resilience to move on, never
sentences.zh: 我想如果那样的话，我最终会陷入完全相同的情况，遇到完全相同类型的人，永远无法培养出继续前进的韧性，永远

sentences.en: having been able to address the real reason that I was attached to these people.
sentences.zh: 无法解决我依附于这些人的真正原因。

sentences.en: I think of the all, you know, all the amazing upsides of being single and alone and happy is the relationship that you get to cultivate with yourself.
sentences.zh: 我认为单身、独处且快乐的所有惊人益处中，最棒的就是你能够与自己培养出的关系。

sentences.en: And really, at the end of the day, our relationship with ourself is the most important one you're going to have in your entire life.
sentences.zh: 说到底，我们与自己的关系是你一生中最重要的关系。

sentences.en: It's the, you know, like when you think about it, the only one that really lasts, that's never going to disappear.
sentences.zh: 当你仔细想想，这是唯一真正持久的，永远不会消失的关系。

sentences.en: It's never going to abandon us or go away.
sentences.zh: 它永远不会抛弃我们或离我们而去。

sentences.en: So consider it your greatest investment and take this time to focus on yourself, focus on your hobbies, focus on your goals, because one day you might look back at this, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以把它视为你最大的投资，利用这段时间专注于自己，专注于你的爱好，专注于你的目标，因为有一天你可能会回首这段，你知道，

sentences.en: glorious, sacred time and regret that you didn't appreciate it more, regret that you didn't recognize the opportunity that you had.
sentences.zh: 辉煌而神圣的时光，后悔自己没有更珍惜它，后悔自己没有意识到你所拥有的机会。

sentences.en: I think it's okay if despite all of this, despite all of these benefits and pros and whatever, you still want a relationship.
sentences.zh: 我认为即使尽管有这一切，尽管有所有的益处和优点，你仍然想要一段关系，这也是没问题的。

sentences.en: But I don't think it should be our entire focus.
sentences.zh: 但我不认为这应该成为我们的全部重心。

sentences.en: You can still believe that you deserve to be loved, deserve that you can be treated right and not settle and also appreciate and love your single life.
sentences.zh: 你仍然可以相信自己值得被爱，值得被正确对待，不将就，同时也欣赏并热爱你的单身生活。

sentences.en: In fact, I think it really goes hand in hand.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我认为这两者是相辅相成的。

sentences.en: But why is it that even when we are really happy being alone, everything is going right,
sentences.zh: 但为什么即使当我们独处时感到非常快乐，一切都很顺利，

sentences.en: everything is going well, we have friends, we're doing really well, we've got opportunities, we feel healthy, we feel happy, we really feel complete.
sentences.zh: 一切进展良好，有朋友，做得很好，有机会，感觉健康，感觉快乐，感觉非常完整时，

sentences.en: Why is it that even in those moments, we still crave affection and romantic love?
sentences.zh: 为什么即使在那些时刻，我们仍然渴望亲密和浪漫的爱？

sentences.en: Why is it that we still feel incomplete sometimes?
sentences.zh: 为什么我们有时仍然感到不完整？

sentences.en: Well, this is a psychology podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 好吧，这是一个心理学播客。

sentences.en: So of course, I really want to give a psychological explanation for this.
sentences.zh: 所以当然，我真的很想对此给出一个心理学解释。

sentences.en: Romantic love gives us the same dopamine rush and hit as things that cause major euphoria and ecstasy, like ecstasy or drugs like sugar, like things that get our neurons firing.
sentences.zh: 浪漫的爱带给我们的多巴胺激增和快感，与那些导致极度兴奋和狂喜的事物相同，比如摇头丸、糖分等药物，这些东西会让我们的神经元活跃起来。

sentences.en: And because we become accustomed to that, well, we're kind of dependent on that feeling of that
sentences.zh: 因为我们习惯了那种感觉，所以我们有点依赖那种

sentences.en: rush and that level of dopamine in our brains from getting, you know, hugs and attention and affection from a partner.
sentences.zh: 从伴侣那里获得拥抱、关注和爱意所带来的那种多巴胺激增的感觉。

sentences.en: That's why it's so hard to move on after a breakup and to really embrace being single because we're
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么分手后很难继续前进，很难真正拥抱单身生活，因为我们

sentences.en: going through literal withdrawal from like a long series of consistent dopamine spikes from someone else.
sentences.zh: 正在经历真正的戒断反应，就像戒掉来自他人的长期持续的多巴胺刺激一样。

sentences.en: And it's totally okay to still want that feeling.
sentences.zh: 仍然想要那种感觉是完全没问题的。

sentences.en: We also need affection to live.
sentences.zh: 我们也需要爱意才能生存。

sentences.en: It's crucial for the release of oxytocin, which is a hormone that plays a really important role in bonding and intimacy and even repairing connections in our brain.
sentences.zh: 它对于催产素的释放至关重要，这是一种在建立联系、亲密关系甚至修复大脑连接方面起着非常重要作用的激素。

sentences.en: It's the hormone that makes you feel love and truSt.
sentences.zh: 它是让你感到爱与信任的激素。

sentences.en: And some studies have also associated it with the bond a mother has with her child through childbirth.
sentences.zh: 一些研究还将它与母亲通过分娩与孩子建立的纽带联系起来。

sentences.en: Without oxytocin, we could feel really empty.
sentences.zh: 没有催产素，我们可能会感到非常空虚。

sentences.en: It's part of the kind of hormonal neurotransmitter equation within our brain that makes us feel content and happy.
sentences.zh: 它是大脑中激素神经递质方程式的一部分，让我们感到满足和快乐。

sentences.en: So if you're not getting it from a romantic partner and you're still craving that connection,
sentences.zh: 所以如果你没有从浪漫伴侣那里得到它，而你仍然渴望那种联系，

sentences.en: you might need to find other ways to restore the feeling it elicits by doing something else
sentences.zh: 你可能需要通过做其他事情来寻找恢复这种感觉的方法，

sentences.en: like hugging a friend, listening to emotional music, having a warm shower, getting a massage, telling someone in your life how much you love them.
sentences.zh: 比如拥抱朋友、听感人的音乐、洗个热水澡、做按摩、告诉生命中的某人你有多爱他们。

sentences.en: And I think this leads on to what I want to talk about to conclude the episode, which is how do we cultivate self-love whilst you're single and how do we cultivate an appreciation
sentences.zh: 我认为这引出了我想在结尾讨论的话题，那就是在单身时我们如何培养自爱，以及我们如何培养

sentences.en: for being alone?
sentences.zh: 对独处的欣赏？

sentences.en: I think first and foremost, all that love that you want to give to a partner, pour it into yourself, into your friends, into your family.
sentences.zh: 我认为首先，把你想要给予伴侣的所有爱，倾注在自己身上，倾注在朋友身上，倾注在家人身上。

sentences.en: Take this really valuable time to build deep connections with the people around you, to treat them the way you would treat a romantic partner, to give them gifts, to tell them you
sentences.zh: 利用这段非常宝贵的时光与周围的人建立深厚的联系，像对待浪漫伴侣一样对待他们，给他们送礼物，告诉他们你...

sentences.en: love them, to spend quality time with them.
sentences.zh: 爱他们，花时间陪伴他们。

sentences.en: And that's going to pay off in dividends in the future, regardless of whether there's a relationship in your future or not.
sentences.zh: 无论未来你是否会进入一段关系，这在未来都将带来丰厚的回报。

sentences.en: I think like that study we talked about earlier, having supportive quality relationships is like the biggest indicator of happiness and well-being.
sentences.zh: 我认为就像我们之前讨论的那项研究一样，拥有高质量的支持性关系是幸福感和幸福指数最大的指标。

sentences.en: So you're not going to lose out if you spend more time with your friends and really trying to promote those relationships.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你花更多时间陪伴朋友，并真正致力于促进这些关系，你并不会有什么损失。

sentences.en: Being single, having a period of singleness is an amazing time to pursue a hobby or a long-term goal and to practice self-improvement.
sentences.zh: 单身，拥有一段单身时期，是追求爱好、实现长期目标和进行自我提升的绝佳时机。

sentences.en: It also puts your mind and your focus back onto yourself rather than on others.
sentences.zh: 它也能让你把心思和注意力重新放回自己身上，而不是别人身上。

sentences.en: I think a lot of people like they go through breakups and like they're like, I'm going to get really fit at the gym.
sentences.zh: 我想很多人在经历分手后，都会说：“我要去健身房练出好身材。”

sentences.en: Do whatever you want, whatever's going to make you happy.
sentences.zh: 做任何你想做的事，任何能让你快乐的事。

sentences.en: But there's a reason that happens because suddenly you're not distracted by this other person.
sentences.zh: 但这发生是有原因的，因为突然间你不再被另一个人分心了。

sentences.en: Suddenly you have all of this time.
sentences.zh: 突然间，你拥有了所有这些时间。

sentences.en: You're not needing to think about them and think about their actions and what's going to impact them and spend time with them.
sentences.zh: 你不需要再去想他们，想他们的行为，想什么会影响他们，也不需要花时间陪伴他们。

sentences.en: All of that energy gets put back onto yourself and you're able to refocus on what you want to achieve, what's going to matter to you in, you know, two or five, ten years.
sentences.zh: 所有的能量都回到了你自己身上，你能够重新专注于你想实现的目标，专注于在两、五年或十年后对你真正重要的事情。

sentences.en: Um, and it's a great period of time to set a really big goal.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是一个设定宏大目标的绝佳时期。

sentences.en: Maybe you want to run a marathon.
sentences.zh: 也许你想跑一场马拉松。

sentences.en: What a great thing to do.
sentences.zh: 这是多么棒的一件事啊。

sentences.en: You, I think you should do that.
sentences.zh: 你，我觉得你应该去做。

sentences.en: I think you should do that.
sentences.zh: 我觉得你应该去做。

sentences.en: And now you have all this time.
sentences.zh: 现在你有了所有这些时间。

sentences.en: There's no, nobody distracting you.
sentences.zh: 没有人在分散你的注意力。

sentences.en: There's nothing getting in your way to really focus on yourself.
sentences.zh: 没有什么能阻碍你真正专注于自己。

sentences.en: I think also it's important to change our mindset rather than being like, I'm lonely.
sentences.zh: 我认为改变心态也很重要，不要总是想：“我很孤独。”

sentences.en: I don't have anyone.
sentences.zh: “我没有人陪伴。”

sentences.en: I'm missing out.
sentences.zh: “我错过了什么。”

sentences.en: Like Valentine's day sucks.
sentences.zh: “情人节糟透了。”

sentences.en: Christmas sucks.
sentences.zh: “圣诞节糟透了。”

sentences.en: I really wish someone was there for me.
sentences.zh: “我真希望有人能陪在我身边。”

sentences.en: Treat this period like it's a growth period, like it is important for your development, which it is.
sentences.zh: 把这段时期当作一个成长期，它对你的发展至关重要，事实也确实如此。

sentences.en: Be like, this is actually a major blessing.
sentences.zh: 告诉自己：这其实是一个巨大的福分。

sentences.en: Switch that mindset from like a lost mindset to a gain mindset.
sentences.zh: 把心态从“失去”转变为“获得”。

sentences.en: Like this is an amazing opportunity.
sentences.zh: 这真是一个绝佳的机会。

sentences.en: Not everyone gets this opportunity to be able to completely and utterly focus on the things that make you happy and make you grow.
sentences.zh: 并不是每个人都有机会能够完全彻底地专注于那些让你快乐、让你成长的事情。

sentences.en: And I think the final thing is know that even if you find your person, you are still entirely complete without them.
sentences.zh: 最后我想说，即使你找到了那个对的人，没有他们，你依然是完整独立的。

sentences.en: And practicing self-love, practicing self-improvement, creating a life that you want to live.
sentences.zh: 练习自爱，练习自我提升，创造你想要的生活。

sentences.en: That is such an important, important goal.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常、非常重要的目标。

sentences.en: And you might even be happier and healthier without someone to join you along in that journey.
sentences.zh: 而且，没有人在旅途中陪伴你，你甚至可能过得更快乐、更健康。

sentences.en: It's something that will benefit you in the future.
sentences.zh: 这对你的未来大有裨益。

sentences.en: It cannot be understated.
sentences.zh: 这一点怎么强调都不为过。

sentences.en: And it's going to really set you up and make you an incredibly happy version of yourself.
sentences.zh: 它真的会为你打好基础，让你成为一个无比快乐的自己。

sentences.en: I think the best part of not having to share your life with someone is that you get to prioritize yourself.
sentences.zh: 我认为不必与人分享生活的最好之处在于，你可以优先考虑自己。

sentences.en: You get to enjoy yourself.
sentences.zh: 你可以享受自己。

sentences.en: You get to set the agenda.
sentences.zh: 你可以制定自己的计划。

sentences.en: And I think that it doesn't mean you have to be happy all the time.
sentences.zh: 这并不意味着你必须时刻保持快乐。

sentences.en: It doesn't mean that you don't want that occasionally.
sentences.zh: 也不意味着你偶尔不会想要有人陪伴。

sentences.en: But being able to adapt to loneliness is a skill and it's a practice that becomes stronger over time.
sentences.zh: 但能够适应孤独是一种技能，也是一种随着时间推移会变得更强的练习。

sentences.en: And as we appreciate where we are and the importance of where we are now more and more,
sentences.zh: 当我们越来越欣赏我们所处的境地以及当下的重要性时，

sentences.en: you're really able to see that being alone and being single and without a relationship is not a loss.
sentences.zh: 你真的会明白，独处、单身、没有伴侣并不是一种损失。

sentences.en: It's actually a huge win.
sentences.zh: 这实际上是一个巨大的胜利。

sentences.en: And there are so many things that you get to do that maybe others in relationships don't.
sentences.zh: 你有很多事情可以做，而恋爱中的人可能做不到。

sentences.en: There's so many hours in the day to spend on yourself and to spend on the relationship you have with yourself.
sentences.zh: 一天中有那么多时间可以花在自己身上，花在你与自己的关系上。

sentences.en: So if you are someone who is struggling with this at the moment, someone who's feeling insecure or self-doubt about the fact that you might not have someone in your life,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你现在正为此挣扎，如果你因为生活中可能没有伴侣而感到不安或自我怀疑，

sentences.en: I hope this helped you out.
sentences.zh: 我希望这能对你有所帮助。

sentences.en: I hope that this kind of set you on a good path and you're able to appreciate, yeah, what this kind of period means for you.
sentences.zh: 我希望这能让你走上一条正确的道路，让你能够欣赏这段时期对你意味着什么。

sentences.en: And you're able to appreciate yourself and your relationship with yourself more and set some long-term goals for yourself.
sentences.zh: 让你能够更欣赏自己以及你与自己的关系，并为自己设定一些长期目标。

sentences.en: Think big.
sentences.zh: 大胆去想。

sentences.en: Cultivate your friendships.
sentences.zh: 培养你的友谊。

sentences.en: Try a new hobby.
sentences.zh: 尝试一种新的爱好。

sentences.en: Try anything you want to do.
sentences.zh: 尝试任何你想做的事。

sentences.en: Like there's nothing stopping you.
sentences.zh: 没有什么能阻挡你。

sentences.en: That's the amazing blessing of this.
sentences.zh: 这就是这段时期令人惊叹的福分。

sentences.en: And thank you so much for listening.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢你们的收听。

sentences.en: I hope you enjoyed this episode.
sentences.zh: 希望你们喜欢这一集。

sentences.en: If you voted on the poll on my Instagram, thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 如果你在我的 Instagram 上参与了投票，非常感谢。

sentences.en: It was an absolute pleasure to be able to talk about it and do this research.
sentences.zh: 能谈论这个话题并进行这项研究，我感到非常荣幸。

sentences.en: I especially love when topics relate to something I'm going through.
sentences.zh: 我特别喜欢那些与我正在经历的事情相关的话题。

sentences.en: Like I think it's so universal to struggle with these feelings.
sentences.zh: 我认为为这些感受而挣扎是非常普遍的。

sentences.en: You're not alone and you're not a bad person.
sentences.zh: 你并不孤单，你也不是一个糟糕的人。

sentences.en: You're not a weak person because you want love.
sentences.zh: 你渴望爱，这并不代表你软弱。

sentences.en: That is such a crucial element of being a human.
sentences.zh: 这是身为人类至关重要的一部分。

sentences.en: But you can get love from so many places.
sentences.zh: 但你可以从很多地方获得爱。

sentences.en: And I hope you know you're not alone in that feeling and it's all going to work out.
sentences.zh: 我希望你知道，你在这种感觉中并不孤单，一切都会好起来的。

sentences.en: So thank you so much for listening.
sentences.zh: 再次感谢你们的收听。

sentences.en: Hopefully I'll hear or you'll hear me next week.
sentences.zh: 希望下周还能听到你们的声音，或者你们能听到我的声音。

sentences.en: You'll be back for another episode.
sentences.zh: 期待你们回来收听下一集。

sentences.en: And as always, if you feel called to do so, please feel free to leave a five-star review on Apple Podcasts or Spotify or wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 一如既往，如果你愿意的话，请随时在 Apple Podcasts、Spotify 或任何你收听播客的地方留下五星好评。

sentences.en: If you don't want to, that's fine.
sentences.zh: 如果你不想，也没关系。

sentences.en: But if you feel called to do so, it is an amazing way to help this show grow.
sentences.zh: 但如果你愿意，这对帮助节目成长来说是非常棒的方式。

sentences.en: And thank you again.
sentences.zh: 再次感谢你们。
